answer: A verdict only settles when 3 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, because each one must be independent on the jade graph and each exposes its bond to the hollow slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the whisper audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. That is 9 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
